items.headline: New two-story house permitted on Wilsham Drive
items.summary: A permit for a new 2-story single-family home valued at $477,573 was issued at 1028 Wilsham Dr. The same address also received a permit that day for a ground-floor JADU, adding a second unit to the property.

items.headline: Stapleton Court property adds two units via ADU permits
items.summary: 1598 Stapleton Ct received permits for a detached two-story ADU ($221,643) and a garage conversion to a JADU ($84,038) on the same day, adding two additional housing units to one lot.

items.headline: Cupertino faces three active lawsuits, council reviews in closed session
items.summary: The City Council met in closed session to discuss ongoing litigation, including cases brought by Lixin (Leon) Chen et al., Yes in My Backyard, and the Garden Gate Coalition for Mary Avenue Safety against the city in Santa Clara County Superior Court.
